# ICRAF_ISRIC

Soil spectral libraries from the ISRIC World Soil Reference Collection (58 countries)

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 4,000+
- **Version:** first release (v1)
- **Spectral range:** vnir, mir
- **Extent:** global

## Map

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/ICRAF_ISRIC/README_files/figure-gfm/map-1.png)

## Database access

[Open dataset files](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/ICRAF_ISRIC/)

## Soil laboratory information

- **n properties available:** 46
- **n properties standardized:** 18
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, country
- **sampling depth:** various
- **geography:** landuse

## MIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** reflectance
- **Original range:** 400-4000
- **Standardized range:** 400-4000
- **Instrument:** FTS-7000 FT-IR Spectrometer
- **Manufacturer:** Digilab (Bio-Rad, Randolph, MA, USA)
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Sample preparation:** Finely ground <0.1 mm
- **Additional info:** Not available

## VNIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** Not available
- **Original range:** 350-2500
- **Instrument:** FieldSpec FR Spectroradiometer

- **Instrument co-scans:** 25
- **Scan repeats:** 2
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Original resolution:** 1
- **Sample preparation:** Air-dried, Sieved < 2 mm
